title: VBCDX role descriptor (role.json)
description: One per role, at <roles_dir>/<id>/role.json in an agent pack (vbcdx-pack.schema.json), next to the role's prompt.md. Every renderer reads the role from this descriptor and that prompt, so a role means the same thing in every harness. It states the role's policy and local capabilities in abstract terms; the installer maps them to each harness's native controls. Every per-field rule is in this schema. Two rules span fields or files and are checked only by the reference loader (src/packs/load.js): id equals the role's directory name, and credential_suffix is the id upper-cased with hyphens as underscores.

id.description: The role id: its directory name, lowercase letters and digits in hyphen-separated words.

credential_suffix.description: The id upper-cased with hyphens as underscores; names the role's credential keys (VBCDX_AGENTS_TOKEN_<SUFFIX>).

description.description: One line saying what the role does; written into harness definitions and A2A cards.

kind.description: A short policy class, for example implementer or inspector; also an A2A skill tag.

enforcement.description: Which of the stances above a harness or credential actually enforces.

web_search.description: True when the role gets a web search tool where the harness supports one.

remote_capabilities.description: Per tool contract (for example vbcdx.forgejo/1), the tools the role may call once a service of that contract is bound. A key may instead name a service, as packs did before contracts; a contract key must be listed in the pack's contracts. Values are tool names.

dependencies.description: Optional. Per service, the tool contract the role's remote capabilities are written against, for example vbcdx.forgejo/1.

external_dependencies.description: Optional and informational: things outside any bound tool that the role's work relies on, and whether they are available. Renderers do not read it.

line.description: One non-empty line of printable text.
